name: Net Speed
author: taiku666
description: Shows the current network download and upload speed in the bar, marked with a down and up arrow.

barWidget.description: Live download ↓ and upload ↑ speed of the active network interface.

schema.label: Interface
schema.description: auto follows the interface with the default route, all sums every interface except lo, or set one explicitly e.g. wlp4s0.

schema.label: Unit
schema.description: bytes shows KB/s and MB/s, bits shows kbit/s and Mbit/s.
